not_met.question: Q9
not_met.lacks: The generator has no example: plugin/best-practice.json names no example or source, and no finished plugin made by this template and passed sits beside it. So a developer has only the slots and their comments, and finds nowhere what the skill, a role's part, its two schemas, the proposal with its steps adapter, and the routes become together in one real plugin, nor how one plugin's values thread through all of them, so they fill their own by guessing at the comments' intent.
